top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one was behind with immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by  caregivers.  The  required training topics are 3. administering medication 4.preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.
